name: Phase 1 — Foundation Completion
objective: Close critical gaps in the existing ISDB-BISEW Connect platform: profile editing, extended profiles, post edit/delete, group chat UI, password reset, email verification, email notifications, and dark mode.
exit_criteria: Users can edit their profile (name, bio, photo, contact)
Extended user_profiles table has correct columns and relations
Posts and comments can be edited and deleted by their authors
Group chat has a working React UI
Email verification is enabled and functional
Email notifications are sent for key events
Dark mode toggle works and persists preference
